name: Geometry Guided Gaussian Points Generation
definition: A differentiable function T (MGadapter) that generates K Gaussian point attributes {(µ, S, R, n)} from each triangle P of an intermediate mesh M, providing explicit geometric guidance to 3DGS.
summary: Geometry Guided Gaussian Points Generation maps triangular mesh normals to 3D Gaussian attributes via a heuristic function, providing explicit geometric guidance that vanilla 3D Gaussian Splatting lacks.
